title: Implement the Dataset transition and trainability authority

verify.summary: Independent rerun: transition_authority 46 passed, dataset_regression 59 passed, migration/head 11 passed, diff_check exit 0; structural-absence grep clean (no external callers/writes to transition fields, no HTTP/UI/export/agent-runtime surface); canonical lock order and same-tx recheck confirmed; LOW non-blocking findings only.

Adversarial probes 10/10: SQL-level gold/trainability guards reject illegal updates, authority/lock semantics fail closed, evidence policy rejects review-kind/unresolved/cross-scope, one redacted dataset_candidate_reviewed per success and zero on rejection, curator_auto confirmed->excluded recompute can_train_on=false; no material findings.

purpose: Implement one locked service transaction as the sole owner of Dataset lifecycle, confirmation, quality, and derived trainability, independently from candidate creation, evidence enrichment, source wiring, and model I/O.
success_outcome: The internal transition command enforces the exact state table, current ActorContext/session/membership/active-Plant/grant and candidate-version locks, allowed evidence refs, stale/concurrent conflict, terminal behavior, derived can_train_on, gold and agent_labeled guards, and one redacted dataset_candidate_reviewed ref per successful mutation; no other service or caller can assign lifecycle/trainability fields.
anti_goals: Candidate schema/creation changes, evidence association, source flow wiring, Dataset Agent advisory persistence, HTTP/UI, or export.
Locking across provider I/O or treating Timeline/model output as transition authority.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-002 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: TASK-047 intentionally exposes no lifecycle command, so a supported pre-implementation transition cannot be observed without first adding this sole authority; alternative proof: preflight direct-assignment/schema guards plus GREEN service-only transition/derivation/anti-assignment matrix; artifact: focused PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-048-T3-FT-014-W2/.

FT-014-AC-003 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the transition boundary is absent; alternative proof: the GREEN forbidden-kind matrix separately records rejection of UI Feed, Timeline, manifest, raw-agent and raw-Companion refs with unchanged rows/events; decisive comparison: error code and row/event count per claim; artifact: evidence-policy matrix.

FT-014-AC-004 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the transition boundary is absent; alternative proof: the GREEN evidence-resolution matrix separately records rejection of empty, unresolved and cross-scope refs while valid canonical same-Farm/Plant refs permit only the exact transition; decisive comparison: error code and row/event count per claim; artifact: evidence-resolution matrix.

FT-014-AC-008 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the transition boundary is absent; alternative proof: the GREEN origin-guard matrix shows every agent_labeled confirm authority returns dataset_transition_forbidden with unchanged lifecycle/trainability/event refs while the raw control may follow only its allowed branch; artifact: origin-guard matrix.
constraints: No HTTP boundary exists in FT-014; the service command accepts current ActorContext and expected status/version only.
Use canonical lock order and recheck current authority in the same transaction as the write; archive/revoke/association races fail closed.
Append failure rolls back; append success followed by commit failure is audit noise and cannot replay the transition.
invariants: can_train_on is recomputed only by this authority and false unless a valid confirmed state plus allowed confirmation/evidence exists.
curator_auto never grants gold and agent_labeled never confirms in MVP.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-002: exact legal/illegal transition, derived value, anti-assignment, expected status/version, row-lock concurrency, archive/revoke and event rollback/noise matrix.
FT-014-AC-003: forbidden evidence-kind matrix with distinct claim results.
FT-014-AC-004: evidence existence and same-Farm/Plant resolution matrix with distinct claim results.
FT-014-AC-008: every confirm source against agent_labeled plus raw controls, exact errors, unchanged rows and zero events on rejection.
